a.lede: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6 to ChatGPT, and it will come with the capability to build more visual responses.
a.title: GPT-6 is coming to all tiers of ChatGPT

b.lede: OpenAI is updating ChatGPT for all users with an “Intelligent UI” that’s more visual—generating interactive elements as part of the chatbot’s outputs.
b.title: The New ChatGPT Is More Show Than Tell
